articles.title: Does Shell (LSE:SHEL) Have More Value After Its ARC Deal?
articles.summary: Shell stock has delivered a strong 5 year run, yet current valuation checks still suggest the shares lean cheap rather than fully priced in. With the company actively reshaping its portfolio through acquisitions and selective project pauses, investors are weighing how much of that story is already reflected in the share price.
